title: Planned Hormuz v1.1.0 portfolio wire contracts
description: Field-level version-1 contracts supporting ADR 0010 and issue #212. Planned schemas are not registered runtime endpoints. Every object is closed and every unbounded-domain scalar/array is bounded. JSON Schema assertions cover serialized structure; the normative domain rules below remain implementation and authorization gates.

x-hormuz-transport.json_encoding: UTF-8 object; duplicate members, non-finite numbers, BOM, unknown fields, and trailing data rejected
x-hormuz-transport.success_http_status: GET=200; a new immutable mutation result=201; exact idempotent replay returns its original status/body; connector receipt=200 after durable commit; no 204 responses
x-hormuz-transport.retry_classification: retryable may be true only for rate_limited or unavailable; retry_after_seconds is null otherwise; a retry still requires safe-read or verified-idempotency semantics
x-hormuz-transport.mutation_idempotency: Idempotency-Key header: 1-128 ASCII letters, digits, underscore, dot, colon, or hyphen; server binds tenant, actor, method, route, and canonical request; conflict fails closed
x-hormuz-transport.query_decoding: single occurrence per key; integer parameters are canonical unsigned decimal; no implicit boolean/string coercion; unknown or route-inapplicable parameters rejected
x-hormuz-transport.cursor_continuation: cursor may be combined only with limit; filters and window are authenticated cursor state
x-hormuz-transport.collection_order: event_at or created_at/generated_at as appropriate, then immutable opaque ID; descending; as_of is fixed on the first page
x-hormuz-transport.body_identity: organization_id, actor_id, roles, and authorization scope are server-owned; request references may only narrow existing authorized scope
x-hormuz-transport.schema_markers: JSON mutation and response envelopes carry schema_id and integer schema_version; GET queries carry no schema markers
x-hormuz-transport.connector_input: GitHub and Linear signature-verified raw provider bytes are not Hormuz request schemas; normalize through the closed work-outcome-event only
x-hormuz-transport.planned_only: No handler, migration, provider call, schema registration, or activation is enabled by this catalogue

x-hormuz-domain-rules.timestamps: Parse valid UTC instants; start_at < end_at. Event, observation and ingestion times remain separate; source time never authorizes scope.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.hierarchy: Resolve parent and owner references within authenticated scope, enforce nearest configured ancestor, immutable kind, acyclicity, and no cross-organization parents.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.updates: Compare expected version/event/generation atomically; create appends version, not mutation. Existing plan creation requires matching ID/version; new plan creation requires both null.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.attribution: active requires an authorized use_case reference; voided requires null. Commit at most one active primary attribution per attempt; preserve all old records.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.budgets: POST budget-plans persists without activation; state is null before its first activation lifecycle. Explicit activation alone updates active_version/generation. Enforce all organization/team/actor/application/work scopes, denies, model intersections, and lowest numeric ceilings.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.cost: Preserve basis/currency/rate-card provenance. not_available has null amount/currency; negative amount only for credit_or_discount. Never turn aggregates into final granular cost or silently convert currency.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.outcomes: Extract only verified opaque source IDs and fixed lifecycle/quality metadata. Never copy titles, paths, names, comments, source, raw payloads, or arbitrary labels into allowed identifier fields.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.coverage: Retain eligible denominator members, including unmatched, unsupported, failed, retried, and excluded evidence as declared. Undefined denominator means null ratio/value and inconclusive, not zero.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.eligibility: eligible requires non-null rule, declared_at, both thresholds, sample_count and observed_coverage; declaration precedes window; observed sample/coverage meet thresholds; guardrails, freshness and comparability pass. Unknown evidence remains null and inconclusive. No global numeric defaults.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.evidence: Only a separately approved predeclared controlled_design may support controlled scorecard/lift. Connector observations stay descriptive; deterministic associations stay associated.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.scorecard: Cohort IDs are unique and all baseline/Pareto references resolve within the same use-case snapshot. Unknown actual model/policy/rate-card evidence remains explicit and may invalidate eligibility; no employee cohort or universal rank.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.recommendation: Source scorecard must be eligible and unexpired. Policy/plan/scorecard/model/rate-card drift or expiry invalidates recommendation. Proposal requires typed budget reference for budget change or candidate policy digest for other types; no arbitrary patch.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.decision: Accepted decision requires matching accepted reason and all server-validated pre_apply_evidence; rejected reason must match rejected decision. Decision alone cannot apply policy; actual activation retains existing authorized workflow.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.pagination: has_more is true iff next_cursor is non-null; continuation cannot widen server roles/scope or alter bound filters/window/schema. Size budgets may shorten pages below limit.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.role_views: Schemas describe maximum structural shapes, not access grants. Finance/platform remain aggregate-only, team leads remain team/descendant-scoped, self access cannot query these routes; raw entity endpoints require separately authorized capabilities from #223.
x-hormuz-domain-rules.evidence_exports: display_name exists only for authorized registry display. Routine logs, exported release/pilot evidence, errors and diagnostics exclude labels and all work content.

opaque_id.description: Opaque server-issued or server-registered identifier, never a name, path, free-text label, or authority. Resolve within the authenticated organization; do not infer access from syntax.

external_id.description: Verified connector source identifier. The connector must select the source ID field, never encode a title, path, URL, body, or actor name as an ID.

version.description: Positive immutable entity or rule version; never a mutable latest alias.

count.description: Non-negative JSON-safe exact count. Unknown is represented by explicit null only where the containing field permits it.

timestamp.description: Valid UTC RFC3339 instant with at most microsecond precision. Invalid calendar dates are rejected; no local or client-implied time zone.

display_name.description: Administrator-entered registry label, at most 120 Unicode code points. Never copied from external work content and never included in routine logs or release evidence.

decimal.description: Exact non-negative base-10 quantity with at most 18 integral and 9 fractional digits. Not a binary float, scientific notation, or implicit currency conversion.

signed_decimal.description: Exact signed base-10 quantity. Negative cost is allowed only for separately identified credits/discounts; lift may also be negative.

fraction.description: Finite ratio in [0,1]; a missing or zero denominator is inconclusive, not a fabricated zero.

currency.description: Source or plan currency code. Different currencies are never summed without a separately versioned conversion basis.

digest.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of approved canonical metadata or a tenant-keyed provenance digest. Never a raw content hash substituted for retained work content.

cost_basis.description: Original cost evidence basis. No aggregate or estimate can be relabeled as final granular invoice evidence.

evidence_level.description: Controlled requires separately approved predeclared design; connectors are descriptive and deterministic joins associated.

reason_code.description: Fixed content-free classification, never caller free text or the rejected value.

window.description: UTC half-open window; start must precede end. Domain validation enforces the endpoint window/resource bound.

work_scope_id.description: Canonical work scope in the authenticated organization.

version.description: Event-time version; do not rebind historical facts to the current version.

work_scope_ref.description: Tenant-qualified versioned work scope; a primary analytic binding must resolve to kind use_case.

provider_id.description: Registered actual provider, distinct from requested provider.

model_id.description: Registered actual model, distinct from requested or routed model.

model_version.description: Provider-reported version, or null when unknown; never guess a version.

model_ref.description: Actual provider/model dimension. Missing actual identity keeps comparison eligibility explicit.

digest.description: Digest of the predeclared rule metadata.

rule_ref.description: Immutable rule reference. Resolve its formula, eligibility, and thresholds rather than executing caller text.

numerator.description: Eligible included quantity, or null when not known; never fabricate zero.

denominator.description: Full applicable eligible quantity, including unmatched and excluded members as declared; null when unknown, never fabricate zero.

ratio.description: Numerator divided by denominator; null for an undefined denominator.

reason_code.description: Why coverage is available or inconclusive.

coverage.description: Coverage with an auditable denominator; never silently drop failures, retries, or unsupported evidence.

coverage_set.description: Coverage dimensions are all present; unavailable evidence is explicit, not omitted.

state.description: Result under the bound guardrail rule.

rule.description: Versioned guardrail definition, null only when missing evidence is reported.

value.description: Exact observed measure, null when unavailable.

guardrail.description: One versioned guardrail observation; missing rules cannot produce a pass.

guardrails.description: Mandatory ADR 0010 guardrails, including freshness and cohort comparability.

rule.description: Predeclared per-use-case metric eligibility rule; null is inconclusive.

declared_at.description: Must precede the measurement window when status is eligible.

minimum_coverage.description: Explicit owner threshold; no global default.

minimum_sample.description: Explicit owner threshold; no global default.

sample_count.description: All eligible samples under the frozen rule, or null when unknown.

observed_coverage.description: Observed eligible coverage, or null for missing/undefined evidence; never fabricate zero.

status.description: Missing or unmet thresholds produce inconclusive.

eligibility.description: Versioned eligibility and thresholds. Structural validation is not proof of predeclaration or underlying data.

amount.description: Exact source amount or null if unavailable; negative only for credit_or_discount.

currency.description: Source currency; null only for unavailable cost.

rate_card.description: Exact configured rate-card version for estimates.

provenance_digest.description: Tenant-keyed safe provenance digest; no source payload.

cost_component.description: A cost component, never an unlabeled mixture of final, aggregate, and estimated values.

value.description: Qualified value; undefined denominators or missing evidence produce null.

numerator.description: Exact numerator under the bound formula.

denominator.description: Exact eligible denominator, including supported failed/retried work.

unit.description: Metric unit; currency is inherited from the cohort cost components.

status.description: Do not report a winner from inconclusive evidence.

metric_result.description: One of the three approved primary metrics; no employee score.

metrics.description: All three primary metrics remain explicit, including inconclusive ones.

attempt_count.description: All attempts in this model bucket.

input_tokens.description: Exact input_tokens or null when unsupported.

output_tokens.description: Exact output_tokens or null when unsupported.

cached_input_tokens.description: Exact cached_input_tokens or null when unsupported.

reasoning_tokens.description: Exact reasoning_tokens or null when unsupported.

cache_and_token_mix.description: Distinct provider token categories; unsupported is not zero.

latency.description: Versioned eligible latency sample, not only successful requests.

retries.description: All eligible retries, not automatically replayed requests; null when retry attribution is unavailable.

driver_observations.description: Fixed driver dimensions for the scorecard; no arbitrary metric-name map.

cohort_id.description: Opaque cohort ID, scoped to this scorecard.

policy.description: Exact pinned policy version, or unknown.

rate_card.description: Exact estimate rate-card version, or unavailable.

cost_components.description: Exact supported cost components, preserving every basis and currency.

connector_coverage.description: Coverage for the connector evidence used by this cohort.

association_rule.description: Exact deterministic join rule version, or explicitly missing.

cohort.description: One comparable model/policy cohort; no person dimension.

digest.description: Digest of immutable evidence bound to the candidate policy.

verification_ref.description: Reference to a server-validated pre-apply proof, not a client assertion that a check passed.

pre_apply_evidence.description: All existing policy checks must be rerun or matched to the exact policy/candidate/scorecard state.

candidate_policy_digest.description: Existing typed candidate policy artifact, not an arbitrary JSON patch; required for policy changes.

candidate_budget_plan.description: Existing immutable plan version; required for budget_plan_change.

recommendation_proposal.description: References to typed policy or budget artifacts. No executable text, generic patch, or automatic application.

limit.description: Maximum page size. Server applies 50 when omitted; a smaller page may be returned.

cursor.description: Opaque authenticated frozen-window cursor; never decoded as client authority.

work_scope_id.description: Optional scope filter intersected with server authorization.

connector_id.description: Optional connector filter, never connector authority.

evidence_level.description: Optional evidence filter; cannot upgrade evidence.

version.description: Exact version for a versioned singleton; omitted means current authorized version.

hormuz.portfolio-query.description: Typed query parameters after bounded single-value parsing. No organization, actor, team, arbitrary sort, or free-text filters. Identity/version markers are catalogue metadata, not query parameters.

anyOf.description: Additional model restriction; empty denies all.

expected_active_version.description: Current active plan version, or null for first activation.

expected_activation_generation.description: Server-resolved activation generation; zero only when never activated.

hormuz.work-budget-plan-activation-reque.description: Explicit compare-and-set activation. Revalidate all ceiling/model intersections; no automatic activation or provider replay.
